    Socle reduction of representation-finite special-biserial algebras #

    For a special-biserial bound-quiver presentation, the kernel of the canonical map to its path-support-hull string algebra is exactly the simultaneous socle ideal of the nonuniserial indecomposable projective-injective modules. The final theorem transports this equality across the literal presentation and primitive-projective presentation chosen by the caller.
